# Decisions

## 2026-10-17

Decision: `D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-ev`. Codex Architect fixes the implementable W2-05a/05b/06/07 EV contract in `.agent/W2-technical-design-ev.md`: effective charger/connector Foundation roles; additive migrations after 0023; the versioned deterministic charger/session pack and registered Lab-to-S2 path; scoped event and meter correlation; immutable session/assessment/Finding revisions and late recompute; supported-energy-only gross tariff scenario with exact source and money gates; selected reads, honest extrapolated EV screens and replay proofs. The W2 vendor-format contract peers cover both cold and EV; physical-source capture and attestation remain pilot gates. This is technical authority for Planner packets, not owner approval of EV screen scope, visual authority, fixture numbers or registry promotion.

Decision: `D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-cold`. Codex Architect fixes the implementable W2-00 source-envelope v4 and W2-01..04 cold-chain contracts in `.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md`: typed public event identity/correlation through the registered gateway and S2 acceptance; additive Postgres migrations after 0019; effective Foundation roles and policy; deterministic thermal, power and publication models; bounded excursion and start-chain assessment; immutable episode/Finding revisions; unpriced exposure with existing source and current-money gates; selected reads, honest v6.9 UI states and replay proofs. W2-00 precedes cold and EV producers; W2-05 is split into EV Foundation and EV producer slices. This is technical authority for Planner packets, not owner approval of proposed W2 screen scope, fixture values or registry promotion.

Decision: `D-2026-10-17-w2-design`. Codex Architect adopts the proposed Wave 2 domain and delivery boundaries in `.agent/architect-W2-design.md` for Planner refinement. Cold-chain excursion and backup-response claims, and EV session/energy claims, must derive from time-valid Foundation bindings and accepted public evidence through the ordinary registered Lab/gateway/S2 path; each domain gets versioned causal simulator packs, deterministic replay cases and a labelled physical-adapter contract peer. Private simulator truth cannot enter product evidence. Findings and money remain exact-revision, source-gated and fail-closed: chamber temperature does not establish spoilage; incomplete sessions are unknown; a tariff scenario is neither collections nor lost revenue. W1 plain-language, visual, deeper-analysis and honest-gap rules apply in every W2 slice. The proposed 22-screen Real-with-honest-gaps scope, core panels and demonstration values await owner confirmation; this decision does not promote registry panels, activate tasks or record owner acceptance. W3 estate and W5 work/health/scenarios remain separate.

Decision: `D-2026-10-17-w1-rail`. Codex Architect applies the owner's full-v69-menu choice as a narrow amendment to the 2026-09-13 navigation rule and `D-2026-10-02-grammar-ownership-test`. The operator rail shows all eleven roots in six v69 groups, headed `OPERATIONS`, `INTELLIGENCE`, `WORK`, `ASSURANCE`, `BUSINESS`, `ADMIN`; only Sites (`/sites`) and Findings (`/findings`) are live W1 links. Other roots are visibly and accessibly `Not available yet` text with no destination or keyboard action; site-scoped pages do not make a cross-site root live. The Simulator Lab workspace-footer link appears only with its registered gated route, and unsupported demo-workspace/count copy is omitted. The navigation guard and route/component tests must prove the full inventory, absent destinations, real live routes, gate behavior, and 390 px access while retaining the separate Site tab/subtab bans. Exact contract: `.agent/architect-W1-UX-07-answers.md`. This decision does not promote panels or record owner acceptance.

+Rule 8 in `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1` is extended exactly: `$assessTables += @('cold_episode','cold_episode_revision','cold_episode_evidence')`; `$consequenceTables += @('cold_consequence_revision','cold_consequence_evidence')`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts all three episode tables and existing `analytic_run*`/`assessment_revision*` rows; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts Finding rows. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction spanning both adapters and job completion, commits only after both have inserted, and retries whole transaction on serializable conflict. `postgres_consequence_store.py` alone inserts both cold consequence tables. +
+### Response vocabulary
+
+Every object includes `as_of: UTC timestamp|null` and `limitation: string|null`. Common `currentness.state` is exactly `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`; `source_provenance` is `{classification: ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|AUTHORED|MIXED|UNKNOWN, source_ids: string[], evidence_ids: UUID[], basis_sha256: string|null}`; root `limitations` is `string[]`. `start_bounds,end_bounds,episode_bounds` are `{earliest: UTC timestamp|null,latest: UTC timestamp|null}`; `duration_bounds,degree_minute_bounds,quantity_bounds,amount_bounds` are `{low: decimal|null,high: decimal|null}`. `gaps` is `[{start:UTC timestamp,end:UTC timestamp,reason:MISSING_PROBE|SUSPECT|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|CONTRADICTORY|UNBOUND,expected_points:int,received_points:int}]`, with half-open bounds. `coverage` is a decimal in `[0,1]` plus `{known_points:int,expected_points:int}` on temperature/evidence cards.
+

+| --- | --- |
+| `status` | `{state: OBSERVED_EXCURSION|NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY,claim_level:OBSERVED|BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY,as_of,limitation}` |
+| `objective` | `{text:string,policy_low_deg_c:decimal|null,policy_high_deg_c:decimal|null,room_asset_id:UUID|null,as_of,limitation}` |
+| `temperature_summary` | `{latest_deg_c:decimal|null,latest_at:UTC timestamp|null,coverage:{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal},episode_count:int,claim_level:BOUNDED|POSSIBLE|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY,as_of,limitation}` |
+| `backup_summary` | `{attempts:int,observed_success:int,observed_failure:int,unknown:int,latest_chain_id:UUID|null,as_of,limitation}` |
+| `causal_strip` | `[{step:GRID|START_REQUEST|START_RESULT|GENERATOR|TRANSFER|BUS|COMPRESSOR|PROBE,state:OBSERVED|MISSING|CONTRADICTORY,at:UTC timestamp|null,evidence_id:UUID|null,as_of,limitation}]` |
+| `findings` | `{count:int,items:[{finding_id:UUID,revision_id:UUID,title:string,claim_level:string,link:string}],as_of,limitation}` |
+| `needs_attention` | `[{code:PROBE_GAP|START_FAILURE|TRANSFER_UNKNOWN|RECOMPUTE_PENDING|POLICY_MISSING,text:string,link:string|null,as_of,limitation}]` |

+| `capabilities[].claim` | `TEMPERATURE_POINT|EXCURSION_BOUNDS|BACKUP_START_RESULT|TRANSFER_POSITION|COOLING_RESPONSE|PRODUCT_EXPOSURE`; `state` = `SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`; `required_roles,missing_roles` = `string[]`; `coverage` = `{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal}`. |
+| Foundation states | `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE`; `commissioning.state=CONFIRMED|UNCONFIRMED`; `contact.state=RECENT|STALE|NEVER`; `messages` are typed role-specific strings above. |

Common `currentness.state` is exactly `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`; `source_provenance` is `{classification: ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|AUTHORED|MIXED|UNKNOWN, source_ids: string[], evidence_ids: UUID[], basis_sha256: string|null}`; root `limitations` is `string[]`. `start_bounds,end_bounds,episode_bounds` are `{earliest: UTC timestamp|null,latest: UTC timestamp|null}`; `duration_bounds,degree_minute_bounds,quantity_bounds,amount_bounds` are `{low: decimal|null,high: decimal|null}`. `gaps` is `[{start:UTC timestamp,end:UTC timestamp,reason:MISSING_PROBE|SUSPECT|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|CONTRADICTORY|UNBOUND,expected_points:int,received_points:int}]`, with half-open bounds. `coverage` is a decimal in `[0,1]` plus `{known_points:int,expected_points:int}` on temperature/evidence cards.

 **Discrete model.** One-minute UTC step, exact decimal arithmetic; default fixture has two 60 kW connectors, 80 kW site import cap, both enabled 08:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-10-06, site non-EV base load 0 kW. State per connector: `UNPLUGGED|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED`, session ID or null, authorization result, requested kW, allocated kW, meter accumulator kWh, fault latch. Private forcing: plug/unplug, authorization accept/deny, request schedule, fault/clear, grid interruption, publication dropout/latency. Initial unplugged, no session/fault, accumulator 0. At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard. Fail run on negative energy, allocated sum above available/site/connector limits, energy residual, state with no valid session, duplicate conflicting forcing or non-monotone time.

 **Discrete model.** One-minute UTC step, exact decimal arithmetic; default fixture has two 60 kW connectors, 80 kW site import cap, both enabled 08:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-10-06, site non-EV base load 0 kW. Private forcing: plug/unplug, authorization accept/deny, request schedule, fault/clear, grid interruption, publication dropout/latency. Initial unplugged, no session/fault, accumulator 0. At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard. Fail run on negative energy, allocated sum above available/site/connector limits, energy residual, state with no valid session, duplicate conflicting forcing or non-monotone time.

+Cold money work is triggered by an appended cold FindingRevision, appended cold episode revision, or a relevant assumption/source-gate revision; a migration trigger inserts a dirty `(site,window,domain='cold_chain')` work row into a new `cold_consequence_work` table with unique dirty key and `DO NOTHING` duplicate suppression. The consequence worker leases by `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, selects the exact settled assessment/Finding basis, writes immutable consequence/evidence rows through `postgres_consequence_store.py`, and marks the dirty row done in the same transaction. Add `cold_consequence_work` to `$consequenceTables`, with only lease/status UPDATE patterns for that table; migration trigger is the sole dirty-row inserter. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` gains pass probes for each named owner/table and the partial-index conflict target, and fail probes for cross-writer insert, UPDATE/DELETE on immutable tables, `DO UPDATE`, and an unlisted conflict arbiter. `configuration-persistence.ps1` must count those new probes and fail closed when an owner is absent. `overlap_group` is SHA-256 of canonical `(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id)` prefixed `cold:`; excursion and backup consequences for that room/window share it.
+
+### Response vocabulary
+
+Every object includes `as_of: UTC timestamp|null` and `limitation: string|null`. Common `currentness.state` is exactly `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`; `source_provenance` is `{classification: ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|AUTHORED|MIXED|UNKNOWN, source_ids: string[], evidence_ids: UUID[], basis_sha256: string|null}`; root `limitations` is `string[]`. `start_bounds,end_bounds,episode_bounds` are `{earliest: UTC timestamp|null,latest: UTC timestamp|null}`; `duration_bounds,degree_minute_bounds,quantity_bounds,amount_bounds` are `{low: decimal|null,high: decimal|null}`. `gaps` is `[{start:UTC timestamp,end:UTC timestamp,reason:MISSING_PROBE|SUSPECT|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|CONTRADICTORY|UNBOUND,expected_points:int,received_points:int}]`, with half-open bounds. `coverage` is a decimal in `[0,1]` plus `{known_points:int,expected_points:int}` on temperature/evidence cards.

+
+Rule 8 in `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1` is extended exactly: `$assessTables += @('cold_episode','cold_episode_revision','cold_episode_evidence')`; `$consequenceTables += @('cold_consequence_revision','cold_consequence_evidence','cold_consequence_work')`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` alone inserts all three episode tables and existing `analytic_run*`/`assessment_revision*` rows; `postgres_finding_store.py` alone inserts Finding rows. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction spanning both adapters and job completion, commits only after both have inserted, and retries the whole transaction on serializable conflict. `postgres_consequence_store.py` alone inserts cold consequence rows and leases/completes work. The ledger alone inserts event evidence, rejection and disposition in one transaction; add exactly `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,source_id,record_kind,event_id) WHERE family='EVENT' DO NOTHING` to `$ledgerConflictAllowed`, matching the partial unique index. No `DO UPDATE` permission is added. The race loser rereads the accepted ID and chooses duplicate/event conflict by canonical SHA before writing rejection/disposition.
+
+Cold money work is triggered by an appended cold FindingRevision, appended cold episode revision, or a relevant assumption/source-gate revision; a migration trigger inserts a dirty `(site,window,domain='cold_chain')` work row into a new `cold_consequence_work` table with unique dirty key and `DO NOTHING` duplicate suppression. The consequence worker leases by `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, selects the exact settled assessment/Finding basis, writes immutable consequence/evidence rows through `postgres_consequence_store.py`, and marks the dirty row done in the same transaction. Add `cold_consequence_work` to `$consequenceTables`, with only lease/status UPDATE patterns for that table; migration trigger is the sole dirty-row inserter. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` gains pass probes for each named owner/table and the partial-index conflict target, and fail probes for cross-writer insert, UPDATE/DELETE on immutable tables, `DO UPDATE`, and an unlisted conflict arbiter. `configuration-persistence.ps1` must count those new probes and fail closed when an owner is absent. `overlap_group` is SHA-256 of canonical `(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id)` prefixed `cold:`; excursion and backup consequences for that room/window share it.
+
+### Response vocabulary
+
+Every object includes `as_of: UTC timestamp|null` and `limitation: string|null`. Common `currentness.state` is exactly `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`; `source_provenance` is `{classification: ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|AUTHORED|MIXED|UNKNOWN, source_ids: string[], evidence_ids: UUID[], basis_sha256: string|null}`; root `limitations` is `string[]`. `start_bounds,end_bounds,episode_bounds` are `{earliest: UTC timestamp|null,latest: UTC timestamp|null}`; `duration_bounds,degree_minute_bounds,quantity_bounds,amount_bounds` are `{low: decimal|null,high: decimal|null}`. `gaps` is `[{start:UTC timestamp,end:UTC timestamp,reason:MISSING_PROBE|SUSPECT|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|CONTRADICTORY|UNBOUND,expected_points:int,received_points:int}]`, with half-open bounds. `coverage` is a decimal in `[0,1]` plus `{known_points:int,expected_points:int}` on temperature/evidence cards.

+### Writer, trigger and transaction contract
+
+The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.
+
+Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: extend `$assessTables` with `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval`; extend `$consequenceTables` with `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence,ev_consequence_work`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and leases/completes work. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied DB transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `consequence_worker.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and work completion. Add no SQL writer to HTTP or domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry. The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds each new table's permitted owner INSERT, rejects foreign owner INSERT, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes one pass/fail probe for both multi-adapter transaction call paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+
+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:66:Foundation topology uses explicit `COLD_ROOM`→`TEMPERATURE_PROBE`, `COMPRESSOR`→room, bus→compressor, generator→transfer→bus relations; every referenced asset must exist, one chamber probe cannot be primary for two rooms, and cycles/duplicate edges are refused. .agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:72:**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. The standalone cold pack owns its generator and bus power port; W2-02 does not compose with mini-grid.
.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:74:Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.

.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:93:Analytic IDs `cold-excursion/1`, `cold-start-response/1`. .agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:95:Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.
.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md:97:Start chain groups by accepted `correlation_id`, generator asset and outage window. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.
+
+Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: extend `$assessTables` with `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval`; extend `$consequenceTables` with `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence,ev_consequence_work`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and leases/completes work. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied DB transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `consequence_worker.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and work completion. Add no SQL writer to HTTP or domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry. The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds each new table's permitted owner INSERT, rejects foreign owner INSERT, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes one pass/fail probe for both multi-adapter transaction call paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+
+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

                    $failures.Add(("The evidence ledger writes only its own tables ($($ledgerTables -join ', ')) " +
                        "and inserts provenance ($($provenanceTables -join ', ')); " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($null -ne $target -and $provenanceTables -contains $target) {
                    $where = "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim())"
                    if ($module.Path -ne $ledgerWriter) {
                        $failures.Add("Only $ledgerWriter writes source provenance table '$target'; $where.") | Out-Null
                    } elseif ($line -notmatch '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+(?:evidence_publication|batch_publication_link)\s*\(' -or
                            $line -notmatch '(?i)\bVALUES\s*\(' -or $line -match '(?i)\bON\s+CONFLICT\b') {
                        $failures.Add(("The evidence ledger only INSERTs provenance rows, one literal statement with " +
                            "its VALUES and no ON CONFLICT (no UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE or upsert); $where.")) | Out-Null
                    } else {
                        $provenanceInsertsSeen[$target]++
                    }
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $accessWriter) {
                    $isInsert = $line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)'
                    $insertOk = $isInsert -and $accessInserts -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()
                    $updateOk = $false
                    foreach ($allowed in $accessUpdates) { if ($line -match $allowed) { $updateOk = $true } }
                    if (-not ($insertOk -or $updateOk)) {
                        $failures.Add(("The gateway access store inserts only $($accessInserts -join ', ') and " +
                            "updates only credential revocation and gateway/source enablement fields; " +
                            "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                    }
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $assessWriter) {
                    $isInsert = $line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)'
                    $insertOk = $isInsert -and $assessInserts -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()
                    $updateOk = $false
                    foreach ($allowed in $assessUpdates) { if ($line -match $allowed) { $updateOk = $true } }
                    if (-not ($insertOk -or $updateOk)) {
                        $failures.Add(("The assessment store inserts only $($assessInserts -join ', ') and updates " +
                            "only a recompute job's lease/retry status or a PENDING job's window; " +
                            "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                    }
                }
                # LR-01 attestations, S6-01a Action rows and S4-05a provenance are insert-only: a permitted INSERT
                # into one of them must not carry an upsert (ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE stays in the INSERT clause).
                if ($null -ne $target -and $line -match '(?i)\bDO\s+UPDATE\b' -and
                        (@('source_clock_attestation') + $actionTables + $provenanceTables) -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Insert-only table '$target' is never upserted (no ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE); " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $findingWriter -and -not (
                        $line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)' -and $findingTables -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant())) {
                    $failures.Add(("The Finding store only inserts into $($findingTables -join ', ') (append-only); " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $assumptionWriter -and -not (
                        ($line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)' -and $assumptionTables -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()) -or
                        $line -match $assumptionUpdate)) {
                    $failures.Add(("The assumption store only inserts into $($assumptionTables -join ', ') and only " +
                        "sets an assignment's recorded_to; $($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $consequenceWriter -and -not (
                        $line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)' -and $consequenceTables -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant())) {
                    $failures.Add(("The consequence store only inserts into $($consequenceTables -join ', ') " +
                        "(append-only); $($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $consequenceWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $consequenceTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $consequenceWriter writes consequence table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $actionWriter -and -not (
                        $line -match '(?i)\bINSERT\s+INTO\s+([a-z_]+)\s*\(' -and $actionTables -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant())) {
                    $failures.Add(("The Action store only inserts into $($actionTables -join ', ') " +
                        "(append-only); $($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $actionWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $actionTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $actionWriter writes Action table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $scheduleWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $scheduleTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $scheduleWriter writes schedule table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($target -eq 'financial_consequence_work') {
                    $failures.Add(("Dirty consequence work is inserted only by the migration 0011/0012 triggers; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $assumptionWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $assumptionTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $assumptionWriter writes assumption table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $findingWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $findingTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $findingWriter writes Finding table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $assessWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $assessTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $assessWriter writes assessment table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -ne $accessWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $accessInserts -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("Only $accessWriter writes gateway access table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($module.Path -eq $pgWriter -and $null -ne $target -and $ledgerTables -contains $target) {
                    $failures.Add(("The Foundation store must not write ledger table '$target'; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
                }
            }
            if ($module.Path -eq $ledgerWriter) {
                $where = "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim())"
                if ($line -match '(?i)\bdo\s+update\b' -or
                        ($line -match '(?i)\bon\s+conflict\b' -and $line -notmatch $ledgerConflictAllowed)) {
                    $failures.Add(("The evidence ledger never upserts; ON CONFLICT is allowed only as its three " +
                        "existing DO NOTHING arbiters; $where.")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($line -match '(?i)\b(?:create|alter|drop)\s+(?:table|index|trigger|function|view)\b|\btruncate\s+(?:table\s+)?[a-z_"]') {
                    $failures.Add("The evidence ledger runs no DDL or TRUNCATE (migrations own DDL); $where.") | Out-Null
                }
            }
            if ($module.Path -ne $ledgerWriter -and $line -match '(?i)\b(?:evidence_publication|batch_publication_link)\b' -and
                    $line -match $sqlWrite) {
                $failures.Add(("Only $ledgerWriter writes source provenance; " +
                    "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).")) | Out-Null
            }
            # The extractor joins split, concatenated and multi-line statements, so the whole clause is checked here
            # (the source-line form of these two rules runs in the driver loop above).
            if ($line -match "$provVerb\s+$provName") {
                $failures.Add("$provRefusal; $($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).") | Out-Null
            }
            if ($module.Path -eq $actionWriter) {
                if ($line -match $actionForbidden) {
                    $failures.Add("The Action store never updates, deletes, truncates, upserts or runs DDL; " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).") | Out-Null
                }
                if ($line -match '(?i)\binsert\s+into\s+([a-z_]+)' -and $actionTables -notcontains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()) {
                    $failures.Add("The Action store only inserts into $($actionTables -join ', '); " +
                        "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim()).") | Out-Null
                }
            }
            if ($module.Path -eq $scheduleWriter) {
                # Case-insensitive (phase-1 review F1): lowercase SQL is an ordinary way to write a statement, so
                # every keyword rule here uses (?i); prose is excluded because each rule needs SQL shape.
                $where = "$($module.Path):${lineNumber}: $($line.Trim())"
                if ($line -cmatch '\b(?:DELETE|TRUNCATE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|GRANT|COPY|MERGE)\b' -or
                        $line -match '(?i)\bdelete\s+from\b|\btruncate\s+(?:table\s+)?[a-z_"]|\bdo\s+update\b|\b(?:create|alter|drop)\s+(?:table|index|trigger|function|view)\b|^merge\s+into\b|^copy\s|\bthen\s+(?:update|delete)\b') {
                    $failures.Add("The schedule store never deletes, truncates, upserts or runs DDL (nor merges or copies); $where.") | Out-Null
                }
                if ($line -match '(?i)\binsert\s+into\b' -and -not (
                        $line -match '(?i)\binsert\s+into\s+([a-z_]+)\s*\(' -and
                        $scheduleTables -contains $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant())) {
                    $failures.Add(("The schedule store only inserts into $($scheduleTables -join ', '); $where.")) | Out-Null
                }
                if ($line -match '(?i)^update\s+\S+.*\bset\b') {
                    $updTarget = if ($line -match $sqlTarget) { $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant() } else { $null }
                    if ($null -ne $updTarget -and -not $scheduleUpdates.ContainsKey($updTarget)) {
                        $failures.Add("The schedule store updates only $($scheduleTables -join ', '); $where.") | Out-Null
                    } elseif ($line -match '(?i)^UPDATE\s+([a-z_]+)(?:\s+(?:AS\s+)?(?!SET\b)[a-z_]+)?\s+SET\s+(.+?)\s+WHERE\b') {
                        # An optional table alias is allowed; SET columns are never alias-qualified in PostgreSQL.
                        $updTable = $Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()
                        $setList = $Matches[2]
                        if (-not $scheduleUpdates.ContainsKey($updTable)) {
    sequence bigint NOT NULL,
    device_id text NOT NULL,
    signal_id text NOT NULL,
    asset_id uuid NULL,
    role text NOT NULL,
    family text NOT NULL,
    measurement text NOT NULL,
    source_time timestamptz NOT NULL,
    published_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    interval_start timestamptz NULL,
    interval_end timestamptz NULL,
    quality text NOT NULL,
    unavailable_reason text NULL,
    original_value_text text NULL,
    original_unit text NOT NULL,
    normalized_value_text text NULL,
    normalized_unit text NOT NULL,
    conversion_kind text NOT NULL,
    envelope_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (envelope_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    envelope_text text NOT NULL,
    foundation_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    binding_set_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    binding_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    configuration_outdated boolean NOT NULL,
    source_mode text NOT NULL CHECK (source_mode IN ('LIVE','SIMULATED')),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_site_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id) REFERENCES site(tenant_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_batch_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, batch_id)
        REFERENCES ingestion_batch(tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_source_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, gateway_id, source_id)
        REFERENCES source(tenant_id, site_id, gateway_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_asset_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, asset_id)
        REFERENCES asset(tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_foundation_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, foundation_revision_id)
        REFERENCES foundation_revision(tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_binding_set_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, binding_set_revision_id)
        REFERENCES signal_binding_set_revision(tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_binding_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, site_id, binding_revision_id)
        REFERENCES signal_binding_revision(tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_message_unique UNIQUE (site_id, gateway_id, source_id, message_id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_scope_unique UNIQUE (tenant_id, site_id, id),
    CONSTRAINT accepted_evidence_published_after_source CHECK (published_at >= source_time)
);
CREATE INDEX accepted_evidence_site_time ON accepted_evidence (site_id, source_time DESC);
CREATE INDEX accepted_evidence_channel_time ON accepted_evidence (site_id, device_id, signal_id, source_time);

The consequence worker leases by `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, selects the exact settled assessment/Finding basis, writes immutable consequence/evidence rows through `postgres_consequence_store.py`, and marks the dirty row done in the same transaction. Add `cold_consequence_work` to `$consequenceTables`, with only lease/status UPDATE patterns for that table; migration trigger is the sole dirty-row inserter. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` gains pass probes for each named owner/table and the partial-index conflict target, and fail probes for cross-writer insert, UPDATE/DELETE on immutable tables, `DO UPDATE`, and an unlisted conflict arbiter. `configuration-persistence.ps1` must count those new probes and fail closed when an owner is absent. `overlap_group` is SHA-256 of canonical `(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id)` prefixed `cold:`; excursion and backup consequences for that room/window share it.
+
+### Response vocabulary
+
+Every object includes `as_of: UTC timestamp|null` and `limitation: string|null`. Common `currentness.state` is exactly `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`; `source_provenance` is `{classification: ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|AUTHORED|MIXED|UNKNOWN, source_ids: string[], evidence_ids: UUID[], basis_sha256: string|null}`; root `limitations` is `string[]`. `start_bounds,end_bounds,episode_bounds` are `{earliest: UTC timestamp|null,latest: UTC timestamp|null}`; `duration_bounds,degree_minute_bounds,quantity_bounds,amount_bounds` are `{low: decimal|null,high: decimal|null}`. `gaps` is `[{start:UTC timestamp,end:UTC timestamp,reason:MISSING_PROBE|SUSPECT|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|CONTRADICTORY|UNBOUND,expected_points:int,received_points:int}]`, with half-open bounds. `coverage` is a decimal in `[0,1]` plus `{known_points:int,expected_points:int}` on temperature/evidence cards.

+### Writer, trigger and transaction contract
+
+The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.
+
+Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: extend `$assessTables` with `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval`; extend `$consequenceTables` with `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence,ev_consequence_work`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and leases/completes work. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied DB transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `consequence_worker.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and work completion. Add no SQL writer to HTTP or domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry. The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds each new table's permitted owner INSERT, rejects foreign owner INSERT, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes one pass/fail probe for both multi-adapter transaction call paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+

Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. The standalone cold pack owns its generator and bus power port; W2-02 does not compose with mini-grid.
 
 Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard. Fail run on negative energy, allocated sum above available/site/connector limits, energy residual, state with no valid session, duplicate conflicting forcing or non-monotone time.

The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans.  **Discrete model.** One-minute UTC step, exact decimal arithmetic; default fixture has two 60 kW connectors, 80 kW site import cap, both enabled 08:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-10-06, site non-EV base load 0 kW. State per connector: `UNPLUGGED|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED`, session ID or null, authorization result, requested kW, allocated kW, meter accumulator kWh, fault latch. Private forcing: plug/unplug, authorization accept/deny, request schedule, fault/clear, grid interruption, publication dropout/latency. Initial unplugged, no session/fault, accumulator 0. At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard.  Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. The standalone cold pack owns its generator and bus power port; W2-02 does not compose with mini-grid.
 
 Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.

+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans.  **Discrete model.** One-minute UTC step, exact decimal arithmetic; default fixture has two 60 kW connectors, 80 kW site import cap, both enabled 08:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-10-06, site non-EV base load 0 kW. State per connector: `UNPLUGGED|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED`, session ID or null, authorization result, requested kW, allocated kW, meter accumulator kWh, fault latch. Private forcing: plug/unplug, authorization accept/deny, request schedule, fault/clear, grid interruption, publication dropout/latency. Initial unplugged, no session/fault, accumulator 0. At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard. Fail run on negative energy, allocated sum above available/site/connector limits, energy residual, state with no valid session, duplicate conflicting forcing or non-monotone time.

To make meter correlation explicit, v4 measurement payload gains optional paired `session_id,connector_id` keys: both required for `ev_connector_energy`, connector must match role asset; existing canonical v4 cold payload without those keys remains readable, while v3 remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Recommend the owner retain this scope; physical capture and `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` remain pilot gates (`.agent/architect-W2-design.md:75-81`; `frontend/docs/architecture/site-first-execution-plan.md:79-86`).
+### Writer, trigger and transaction contract
+
+The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.
+
+Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, and `ev_consequence_work` to `$consequenceWorkTables`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and leases/completes work. The consequence writer branch allows `UPDATE ev_consequence_work SET status=...,lease_owner=...,lease_until=...,updated_at=... WHERE id=...` with only those four assigned columns, and rejects runtime work INSERT, other UPDATE and DELETE. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables + $consequenceWorkTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `consequence_worker.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and work completion. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work UPDATE, rejects runtime work INSERT, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+
+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

+### Writer, trigger and transaction contract
+
+The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.
+
+Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, and `ev_consequence_work` to `$consequenceWorkTables`. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and leases/completes work. The consequence writer branch allows `UPDATE ev_consequence_work SET status=...,lease_owner=...,lease_until=...,updated_at=... WHERE id=...` with only those four assigned columns, and rejects runtime work INSERT, other UPDATE and DELETE. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables + $consequenceWorkTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `consequence_worker.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and work completion. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work UPDATE, rejects runtime work INSERT, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+
+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

-**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. Explicit external electrical port supplies bus power; if composing with mini-grid, use its actual port output and no duplicate generator truth.
+**Time and state.** Fixed 1-minute UTC step; all updates use exact rationals/decimal text and a defined end-of-step publication order. State: chamber air temperature `T` degC, controller demand, compressor `OFF|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, grid/backup bus energized flags, generator `STOPPED|STARTING|RUNNING|FAILED`, transfer position `GRID|BACKUP|OPEN`, door `OPEN|CLOSED`, probe `OK|FAILED`. Private forcing: ambient `Ta`, door schedule, grid loss, generator failure, probe failure; private truth never serializes into a product envelope. Initial `T=3°C`, `Ta=20°C`, door closed, compressor off, grid and bus on, generator stopped, transfer grid, probe OK. Per minute, `heat_kWh = (heat_leak_kW_per_C*(Ta-T) + door_open*door_heat_kWh*60)*1/60`; `cool_kWh = compressor_running_and_bus_powered*cooling_kW*1/60`; `T_next=T+(heat_kWh-cool_kWh)/thermal_capacity_kWh_per_C`. Defaults: thermal capacity `1.2 kWh/degC`, leak `0.08 kW/degC`, door heat `0.02 kWh/min` (stored as `1.2 kW` equivalent while open), cooling `3 kW`, compressor start delay 1 minute, generator start delay 2 minutes, transfer delay 1 minute, start timeout 5 minutes, control on `T>=4°C`, off `T<=2°C`, policy `[2,4]°C`, hysteresis 0.2°C, probe bound ±0.1°C. Clamp no state: fail run if `T` outside `[-40,60]°C`, energy residual nonzero, negative capacity/power, or impossible transition. The standalone cold pack owns its generator and bus power port; W2-02 does not compose with mini-grid.
 
 Grid loss opens transfer and deenergizes compressor bus; controller emits `START_REQUEST` only if backup enabled, generator reaches RUNNING after delay unless failed, transfer closes to BACKUP after delay if generator power exists, and compressor restarts after its own delay if controller still demands cooling. Failed start emits `START_RESULT/FAILED` at timeout; successful start emits `START_RESULT/SUCCEEDED` when running. Transfer result is emitted only if a position sensor is configured; absence stays absence. Door events are sensor transitions; door opening adds heat only while open. Probe failure emits one `UNAVAILABLE` reading with reason `SENSOR_FAILURE` if the profile publishes it, then no numeric sample; reporting-path loss emits no envelope. Device measurement is `T + fixed observation bias` (default 0), rounded to 0.1°C by half-even rule; no private cause field. Controller and power events use observed public transitions and stable correlation ID.

 Excursion begins after two consecutive GOOD observations above upper band (or below lower band) at least 5 minutes apart; return requires two consecutive observations inside band by at least 0.2°C. The start is bounded by `[last in-band, first out-of-band]`; return by `[last out-of-band, first stable in-band]`; duration low = max(0, earliest return - latest start), high = latest return - earliest start, computed only across continuously covered spans. Initial out-of-band sample with no prior in-band gives unknown start; window end without return gives open episode and no finite high. `degree_minutes` bounds use observed rectangles only between adjacent usable samples <=10 minutes apart: low uses min adjacent exceedance, high max adjacent exceedance times interval minutes; add no unobserved gap area. Peak is the maximum **observed** value. An exposure Finding requires 15-minute lower duration and coverage >=0.8; otherwise `POSSIBLE` or `UNKNOWN`, never “no excursion” from missing samples. In-band fully covered is `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` scoped to window, not equipment health.

The 0020 ledger event-conflict target/allowlist and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work UPDATE, rejects runtime work INSERT, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.
+
+`0026` adds `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, status `PENDING|LEASED|DONE|FAILED`, lease_owner/lease_until nullable, created_at/updated_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` leases with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, writes a Site window revision and links, and marks work done atomically. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by the existing unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

 **Discrete model.** One-minute UTC step, exact decimal arithmetic; default fixture has two 60 kW connectors, 80 kW site import cap, both enabled 08:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-10-06, site non-EV base load 0 kW. State per connector: `UNPLUGGED|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED`, session ID or null, authorization result, requested kW, allocated kW, meter accumulator kWh, fault latch. Private forcing: plug/unplug, authorization accept/deny, request schedule, fault/clear, grid interruption, publication dropout/latency. Initial unplugged, no session/fault, accumulator 0. At each minute: apply forcing ordered `(time,connector,kind)`; a plug assigns next deterministic scoped session ID; authorization takes 1 minute; acceptance emits START when CHARGING begins; denial produces no START and is a contextual observed state, not a failed session. Allocate shared available power `max(0,site_limit-base_load)` by connector ID ascending in round-robin 1 kW quanta among charging connectors up to `min(request,connector_limit,charger_limit)`; persist round-robin pointer so no connector monopolizes successive minutes. `E_next=E+allocated_kW/60`, exact kWh. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. Fault clear requires explicit forcing and emits CLEAR; a new plug creates a new session. Simultaneous END/ABORT or START twice for one ID is prohibited by simulator sanity guard. Fail run on negative energy, allocated sum above available/site/connector limits, energy residual, state with no valid session, duplicate conflicting forcing or non-monotone time.
